data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal and the GitHub-to-mail flow right, but it leaves out the step of opening the blog to find the latest post title, so there is no blog parameter. It also treats values the workflow should look up (followers, stars, language, latest post) as inputs, never names the fixed hiring@example.com recipient, and says "send or discard" when the workflow should always discard and never send.
